clips.title: The story
paras: At Whelgar's Excavation Site, Ormer Ironbraid faces a raptor threat that has driven the dwarven workers away. He remains at the dig, seeking allies to reclaim it.

Ormer Ironbraid came to the Wetlands with the dwarven effort to uncover Titan relics and ancient history at Whelgar's Excavation Site. The work stirred packs of fierce Wetlands raptors, or at least drew them to the dig. Now beasts prowl among the ruins where Ormer's team hoped to study ancient earthenware and tablets. The raptors have disrupted their work, and Ormer's anger toward them runs deep.

Ormer will not abandon the dig, though he cannot drive the raptors out alone. He asks passing travelers to kill the beasts, beginning with smaller ones and taking on larger, fiercer raptors in turn. Reclaiming the excavation means recovering the artifacts, but the fight has become personal: Ormer wants vengeance for the work the raptors disrupted and the dwarven pride wounded by their presence.
